environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed as a standalone container on an EC2 instance with a public-facing ALB. No service mesh. The ALB forwards all traffic including WebSocket upgrades directly to port 8080. No Origin validation, no CSRF protection on WebSocket handshake. Session IDs are predictable (logged in CloudWatch access logs accessible to any developer). CORS allows any origin.

config.network: Public subnet, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
